experiment: Endpoint acceptance with six active experts and complete native optimizer state
acceptance: Full eight-expert token-weighted check loss reduction > max(1e-6, twice initial repeated-forward range); no confidence or speed gate. Refresh check each episode.
state_policy: Restore accepted prefix complete Muon/Adam moments, step, EMA and pending quantile betas into eight-expert interpretation; use pending betas for endpoint loss; rollback all state if rejected.
clock_policy: Data and optimizer clock advance by accepted prefix plus one native update; discarded proposal work remains charged. Native stochastic routes disabled in this recipe; any step-derived RNG follows restored step.
baseline: Paired native continuation from identical full state, identical data through accepted cursor; same two-microbatch accumulation and schedule2698.
measurement: Fixed monitor batches and independent per-episode fresh batches excluded from selection; report paired loss differences over episodes and native-only recovery. These are unused windows of the pretraining stream, not a separate benchmark corpus.
cost: Measure synchronized update, acceptance, on-device state-copy and diagnostic costs separately; record total allocated GPU-time.
scope: Three initialization seeds, original 1.03B Belay; larger model replication remains a possible later extension, not required for this initial trajectory study.
snapshot_policy: Preserve independently copied device buffers; full state stays sharded on eight GPUs. No host staging of proposal prefixes.
revision: v3: add within-process complete snapshot and native-update equality diagnostic, and W&B recovery logging. Same learning algorithm as v2.
